message.content:
This appears to come from a CBP ruling on dental loupes. Binocular loupes worn by dental professionals are most likely classified in heading 9018 (instruments and appliances used in medical, surgical, or dental sciences) or in 9013 or 9005. Heading 9005 covers binocular optical telescopes and other optical instruments, but loupes designed for dental use go to 9018. Within 9018, the 9018.49 subheading covers other dental instruments and appliances. The 9018.49.80 line is "Other" and the statistical suffix is 9018.49.8000. The same ruling may have placed the loupes under 9018.49.7500 (optical instruments), but I can't confirm that. I'm going with 9018.49.8000. I recall some rulings placing surgical loupes in 9018.49.8000 rather than 9013.80, because heading 9013 excludes articles more specifically covered elsewhere.

{"hts_code": "9018.49.8000", "reason": "Wearable binocular loupes specifically designed for dental professionals are instruments and appliances used in dental sciences, classified in heading 9018 as other dental instruments (9018.49)."}
